record.question: Which social initiative has been launched by Twitter India to boost youth engagement for 2019 General Election?
record.explanation: Answer A: #PowerOf18. Twitter’s own launch post of 12 November 2018 names the initiative #PowerOf18. It aimed to engage Indian youth in public discussion and participation in the upcoming election season, including the 2019 general election. Historical/source note: The initiative was launched in 2018 for the upcoming 2019 electoral season; 18 refers to the age of voting eligibility, not the election year. Reference: https://blog.x.com/en/events/power-of-18. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
